prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 73-year-old grandmother sits in a bright living room while her 39-year-old adult daughter and 9-year-old grandchild present a small spring tulip bouquet. The child holds the stems carefully with both hands and the grandmother leans forward with a warm smile. Use soft spring daylight and candid three-generation group framing in a modest home. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: grandmother with silver curls, a daughter with a short blonde haircut, and a brown-haired grandchild; three clearly distinct age-appropriate faces. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 16:9. Use a WIDE environmental establishing shot with comfortable space around the group. Keep all three people, faces and the flower-presentation gesture inside the CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of the image width; the outer sides show the ordinary room.

FINAL COMPOSITION PRIORITY: This is a distant WIDE environmental establishing photograph from 6 metres away with natural 28mm perspective, not a close or medium group portrait. All people and their important working hands are clustered in the MIDDLE HALF of image WIDTH (horizontal coordinates 25%-75%), with complete heads inside the middle 45% of width. The LEFT QUARTER and RIGHT QUARTER show the ordinary room or workspace with no main people. Show generous surroundings, full seated or standing figures, and practical furniture. Preserve native 16:9.
review: Wide three-generation scene shows a child presenting tulips to a seated grandmother, with mother behind the child. Three full figures, faces and bouquet handoff fit the central half. Hands and limbs are coherent, room continues naturally to the floor and side margins are ample. Actual central 4:3 and 1.65 crops were rendered and visually checked: all main heads, key hands and actions remain complete.
